title: UAAP: Coach Louie Alas owns up to Ateneo’s early exit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Coach Louie Alas took the blame for Ateneo’s failed Final Four bid in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. The Blue Eagles ended their campaign on a winning note on Wednesday, beating cellar-dweller University of the East, 86-81, to finish with a 6-8 record. “Pasensya na (I’m sorry),” said a somber Alas. “In the three games that I wasn’t there because of suspensions, if we had won maybe just two of those, we might still be in the running [for the Final Four].
